question: What is the average mortality rate across all ten states shown? (A) about 15.5 per 100k (B) about 22.0 per 100k (C) about 18.5 per 100k. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health bar chart. The y-axis starts just below the smallest bar instead of at 0, exaggerating differences. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): truncated axis. True answer: A (about 15.5 per 100k). Bait: C (about 18.5 per 100k).
